variants.name: 1：灯りのある見出し
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE full portrait iPhone settings screen, high-fidelity native iOS mockup, no phone hardware frame, no collage, no design labels.
Input image 1: accepted STRUCTURAL reference — preserve its readable FOUR-ROW radio list, generous text, selected こまめ state, interval selector, near-black base, warm cream palette, three-tab bottom navigation. Input image 2: PIXEL-ART STYLE reference only for warm lamp light and textured pixel illustration. Do NOT put the whole city illustration behind settings. The user finds image1 too sterile and monotonous: introduce subtle atmosphere and a little meaningful imagery without sacrificing readability or turning this into a fantasy dashboard.
Top page title is only 設定, no English kicker or explanatory subtitle. Use spacious Japanese text, 16pt main rows and 13pt descriptions, warm white strong contrast. The functional list is essential, DO NOT replace it with a segmented mode selector.
Content:
作業時間の確認: four radio rows なし / 計測時間をそのまま反映; 軽め / 60分以上の作業終了時に確認; 毎回 / 作業終了時に確認; こまめ / 終了時と作業中に確認. Select こまめ with warm cream check circle.
作業中の確認間隔: 15分 30分 60分, select 30分.
Replace the previous generic help links with EXACTLY TWO new navigable entries: はじめの案内 (replay onboarding, use a simple book/open-door icon) and 画面ガイド (use a screen/tap icon). They are future content destinations, ONLY render the entry UI, do not invent their contents or show a coming-soon alert.
Under アプリについて, add a clear accessible row プライバシーポリシー with shield/document icon and chevron. DO NOT render policy text or make unsupported privacy promises. Small collapsed 開発者向け row can follow. Small LOFI 0.1.0 footer.
Bottom rounded dark tab bar with laptop 作業, stacked cards コレクション, gear 設定 selected in cream. Main list remains comfortably readable; concise help area with no paragraphs; fit privacy link above navigation without reducing text to microscopic size. No streaks, no account, no subscriptions, no new switches or stats, no excessive gold borders. Keep black-centered calm mood.Variant 1: introduce a short atmospheric header at the top, with large crisp 設定 on left and a SMALL cropped pixel-art brass desk lamp and foliage vignette on far right, dissolving into black, occupying at most 10% of screen height. Use a warm amber glow only around this vignette; no city skyline or unlocked scenery spoilers. The functional radio group is rich charcoal with subtle soft material, no hard glossy gradient; selected row has a restrained warm olive/amber tint and a tiny accent line on its left. Fine subtle separators. Interval selector in a separate low charcoal card. For guides use two generous plain list rows in one card, each with a small amber line icon, Japanese labels and chevrons. Privacy row is clear and neutral. It should feel like sitting near a warm lamp, beautifully tactile but still obviously settings.
